items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: And at the time, Jody was in the audience.

ctx.x: from Wednesday until Sunday, and the alternate night trio or whatever, Monday and Tuesday. So he has the microphone and he is about to announce, you know, and Sol Tenenbaum says, "This Monday and Tuesday, the Wilbur Ware Trio!" And Max looked around and said, "You done played me up on my gig."
And this was such a surprise --and a joyful one for me, and at the time, Jody was in the audience.
